notes.title: Thank you! + (The Cleanup)
notes.notes:
Hey there chefs! 
[b]We couldn't be happier with the warm, cheesy reception you've given us! Almost 100 reviews at 98% positive is incredible, and we couldn't be more grateful.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216594/2728242f15b239a904f4c33a938a9d8ba32287bf.png[/img]

We've got one steaming hot (small) patch coming your way, post-release!

[list]
[*] The town has had a small cleanup, including making some layouts & camera angles a little bit clearer.
[*] Some toppings have been adjusted to make the "Picky Eater" achievement just a [i]liiittle[/i] bit less picky.
[*] [strike]Someone new has moved into town.[/strike]
[/list]

notes.title: Game Launch!
notes.notes:
[h2]Thanks for joining us during our Steam launch![/h2]

Grab a pizza, bounce around and deliver delicious, lovingly-made pizza pies to your customers! Show the greedy Pizza Corps you won't be driven out of town so easily.

[b]Join us in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/uQusFFwkmv]Discord server[/url] and share clips, give feedback and have a good time![/b]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
After a few months of Early Access on Itch, we've now made it to Steam, now boasting achievements, quality of life additions, reworked areas of the level, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216594/938ab043cc3014d7e63b6eeefd05456abe1bc868.png[/img]

Here's the full list of changes in our new and shiny Steam release:
[list]
[*] Are you the best chef around? Prove it by getting all of the new Steam Achievements!
[*] Parts of the town have been reworked to allow you to truly show off your pizza moves!
[*] Need a refresher? We've added a "Moves & controls" screen to the pause menu.
[*] There's now also a "quick level restart" button for those speed junkies out there!
[*] Bob your head to the extended level music!
[*] Many quality of life improvements have been included in your delivery, including invincibility frames, auto-applying settings, etc.
[*] Curious about what team Funny Rock Image gets up to? Check out the new behind-the-scenes images in the credits!
[*] Bugs, bugs, and more bugs annihilated. That was the last of them... right?
[/list]
